FULL TEXT:
Centre for Stem Cell Tissue Engineering and
Biomedical Excellence
(Pharmaceutical Extension Block – 2nd Floor)
Panjab University, Chandigarh–160014
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Applications are invited for one post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) in the Centre for
Stem Cell Tissue Engineering & Biomedical Excellence, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be
filled in through Walk-in-interview, purely on temporary basis, for the academic session July
– December 2024.
Minimum qualifications for the posts are as per UGC norms.
Qualifications for the post of one (01) Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor)
Essential Qualification:
(i) M.Sc. in Stem Cell & Tissue Engineering/ Biochemistry from an Indian
University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University with good
academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least 55% of the
marks (50% in case of SC/ST/OBC/Physically & Visually handicapped) or an
equivalent grade in a point wherever grading system is followed at Master’s degree
level.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the
National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR/GATE.
(iii) The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with
the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award
of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the
minimum eligibility condition of NET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant
Professor or equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
Desirable Qualification:
 Ph.D. degree in Stem Cell & Tissue Engineering/ Biochemistry with at least two-
years of research experience or teaching experience of post-graduate classes in the field
of respective subject with relevant publication/s in peer reviewed journals.
Honorarium:
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate has to undertake that he
/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and will
do the same till they are teaching in the Centre for Stem Cell Tissue Engineering & Biomedical
Excellence.
Instructions for applicants:
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time of interview on
18th November 2024 at 11:30 AM (reporting time).
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professors available at
website http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php (pages 1 to 9).
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Interview will be held on 18th November 2024 (Monday) at 12:00 Noon in the Committee Room
of the Centre for Stem Cell Tissue Engineering & Biomedical Excellence, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
Sd/-
(Dr. Seemha Rai)
Chairperson
